thread:
maria_cs: Hi team — kickoff for Cobalt sprint‑0 (private VPC). Quick sync on egress path, KMS access, and audit log forwarding. Customer needs Splunk ingestion + 30d retention and a KMS key that the SIEM can decrypt with.
hana_customer: Hi! We're ready to receive logs via PrivateLink. Need confirmation on who will provision the KMS key and rotation window. Will Redwood create the role or do we?
liam_network: Recommend PrivateLink -> Splunk HEC. Egress will be blocked by default; we can open specific CIDRs or use PrivateLink endpoints. Do you have destination DNS/IP and certs or do you want us to create the endpoint?
hana_customer: We'll provide the HEC PrivateLink endpoint DNS and certs. Prefer customer-owned endpoint with our cert pinned.
sophie_se: For KMS access we'll need a cross-account role with kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Decrypt for the Redwood service principal. Example snippet to share with security (trimmed):
```json
"Statement": [{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodService"},
  "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey*","kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789"
}]
```
rahul_infra: Minor security note: avoid Resource: "*" in policy. We'll supply the exact service principal ARN once infra is provisioned. For audit logs, we plan CloudTrail -> S3 with SSE-KMS; confirm if the customer requires separate encryption key for logs.
maria_cs: Action items: (1) Hana to share Splunk PrivateLink DNS + cert by EOD, (2) Sophie/Rahul to provide finalized IAM/KMS snippets, (3) Liam to propose minimal egress rules and the route table change window. Also flagging renewal risk — customer is in an accelerated trial; any delays here affect go‑live.
aiden_success: :thumbsup: I'll add notes to the enablement playbook and open a renewal watch with account exec.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket CS-4821 (private-deploy) assigned -> @rahul_infra, due 2024-06-05.
rahul_infra: I'll attach a minimal IAM trust and an example KMS grant in the ticket. Quick question: do they want separate keys per env (prod/stage) or single prod key only?
hana_customer: Prod only for now — stage can use default. Retention 30d is target; may extend later.
sophie_se: Got it. I'll post a draft key policy and rotation cadence (90 days) to the shared doc and tag @maria_cs. Draft link: https://redwood.app/docs/cs/cobalt-sprint0 (placeholder).
liam_network: One more ops note: for PrivateLink we need the Splunk cert in PEM and a 15m maintenance window to modify the route table / endpoint associations.
maria_cs: Thanks everyone — sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. If blockers pop up before then, please @mention me. I'll consolidate the action items and follow up on CS-4821.
